*Now working session is ended, feel free to review and add any feedback on the solution draft.*

Closing this conflicting draft as superseded by the current publishing pipelines
and the same-commit release work in PR 341:
https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/pull/341.

The draft's Go `go_` release identity differs from the module's current
`go/vVERSION` tags. Java now uses JDK 21 and Central Portal rather than the old
OSSRH/JDK 11 assumptions. Current logs prove that absent Central/signing secrets
cause publishing to be skipped; rebasing the old draft cannot supply those
credentials. PR 341 makes missing credentials fail, waits for Central publication,
verifies the public namespace and exact artifact, and gates GitHub releases on
that evidence. Java delivery remains explicitly blocked by provider setup.

Issue 192 remains open for actual delivery. The branch is preserved, and the
draft, all comment types, run inventory, and available linked traces are archived
in `docs/case-studies/issue-339/data/` on PR 341.
